claims.how: The Kelber review gives 0.25 cycles per degree for Apis mellifera object discrimination, taken directly from that record.
The Paffhausen passage gives about 300 degrees for the bee field of view, taken directly; it is a general bee figure, so grade g.
The BEE matrix takes the honeybee worker peaks of 346, 430 and 540 nm from the van der Kooi compilation, which the three records state.

quotes.quote: Bees can see ~300° horizontally on the body plane with low spatial resolution for peripheral ommatidia
